_about: How Ayaan actually builds, condensed from ~/Developer/AgentOS (AGENTS.md, CODE-STYLE.md, UNSLOP.md, skills/*). Hand-maintained for now. /build reads this to (a) show the real pipeline as tool calls and (b) make the generated app follow the house style. Skill names and one-line descriptions are public; style and voice rules go into the model prompt only and are never printed. See docs/build-playbook.md for how to extend.

pipeline.desc: turn an ask into a well-formed issue: title, acceptance criteria, out of scope
restate the acceptance criteria in one message; one sharp question before code, never an interrogation
decide how much code to write: does this need to exist → reuse → stdlib → native platform → existing dep → one line → minimum that works
house style for anything typed: strict types, early returns, named exports, sparse why-comments
one file, the minimum that passes the acceptance criteria
evidence over vibes: doctype, size, no network, a11y basics
atomic conventional commit with scope, never a blanket git add -A
pr body in the house format: what, why, how to verify
ship it. small change, live in under a minute

style: simplest thing that works. no unrequested abstractions, helpers, flags, or error handling for cases that can't happen.
strict about types even in plain js: no implicit any-shaped objects; small named functions; early returns over nested ternaries; ?? over || unless falsy coercion is intended.
booleans named is*/has*, never negated (isNotReady is wrong).
named functions, one concern each. no god-function. keep the file under 250 lines.
validate at the boundary (user input, localStorage reads); trust internal code past it.
fail closed: bad input does nothing, never something surprising.
comments are sparse and say why, not what. no banner comments.
accessibility is not traded for brevity: real <button>s, labels on inputs, focus visible, contrast readable, works with keyboard.
mobile first, system font stack, one accent color, whitespace does the layout.
no external requests of any kind. no cdn, no fonts, no images from urls, no fetch.
voice: lowercase, short sentences, say the thing and stop.
no em dashes. periods or commas.

banned words: delve, robust, comprehensive, seamless, powerful, cutting-edge, leverage, elevate, streamline, additionally, crucial, enhance, fostering, showcase, tapestry, testament, underscore, vibrant.
no 'not just x, but y'. no rule of three for its own sake. no puffery.
no chatbot phrases: 'i hope this helps', 'let me know', 'great question'.
sentence case headings. no decorative emojis. straight quotes.
say what it does, not how it feels. mechanism or number over adjective.
active voice. plain word over the fancy synonym.
